layouts.name: RAF Woodbridge
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independent venue description identifies the wide, open runway used for driving experiences. The supplied layout diagram identifies the straight runway rather than a taxiway circuit. Exact nodes from the complete publicly mapped runway way are retained; taxiways, invented turnarounds and parallel offset lanes are excluded. The 3,160.8 m physical runway trace differs by 2,497.2 m from the catalogue scalar. That discrepancy is unresolved and no 5,658 m timed route is claimed. Public data is the full supporting runway centerline, not an independently verified start-to-finish run. Its mapped endpoints are the runway ends, not verified timing gates. The private preview alone trims the displayed line at the local start and finish projections; no private coordinates are published. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3160.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
